Question 11
?

Find the domain of the function f(x,y)=arcsin⁡(x2+y).

a
{(x,y)∈R2:0≤x2+y≤π}
b
{(x,y)∈R2:−π≤x2+y≤π}
c
{(x,y)∈R2:−π2≤x2+y≤π2}
d
The domain is the entire xy-plane
e
{(x,y)∈R2:−1≤x2+y≤1}
